explication: ShredOS is a bootable disk-erasure environment that starts nwipe directly. The principal workflow is booting the media, reviewing detected drives, selecting an erasure method and options, confirming the selection, and wiping; the system can then produce certificates and logs. The README also documents unattended, PXE, persistent-configuration, custom-script, and headless workflows. The supplied tree and excerpts are mostly Buildroot infrastructure, not ShredOS or nwipe runtime implementation, so paths and links for those documented capabilities are left unspecified where the evidence does not establish them.
